items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Well, he taught the Junior Shrine Band. I was in the Junior Shrine Band in 1923 when we went to Washington, D.C.

ctx.x: Not to Tossel. No, no. This was before. Before Tossel. Tossel was born, even. Okay. Okay. Tossel was two years old then. And Dr. McAfee, he was a dentist. He was a conductor. But they had Mike Kupera playing first trumpet. And Mike Kaplan. And my daddy. And another fellow. I can't remember his name, but he was good. They had four trumpet players. They were terrific players. They had Lamar Harrison playing clarinet. And this fellow, Jufria, used to be the clarinet player at the Orphium Theater. He was a very fine,…
Was he related to Mark Warneau?
